horoscopes.horoscope: You will achieve things today, not by the sleight of your hand but by your communication skills, says Ganesha. Your eloquence shall win many hearts. The stars suggest monetary benefits, but you need to guard against injury and minor ailments. After office, catching up with your old friends or chilling out with new pals will be the first thing on your mind. After all, you enjoy the company of the friends who support you always everywhere. Therefore, spending a special time with your special friend will bear something meaningful to you, feels Ganesha. Ganesha says that you are likely to get exhausted while doing your routine tasks. Do not hesitate – seek assistance of juniors and seniors in your workplace to complete difficult tasks. Then, take a break to rejuvenate your mind and body. You might have to spend on the health of elderly members of your family. Chances of very high range expenses while are very less, you are likely to spend money on small small requirements. Today, you will tickle everyone’s funny bone with your incredible sense of humour. However, at work, you will be serious and pay more attention to the projects under your purview, says Ganesha. You will be ready to give your best shots and be the ultimate champion in finishing up the pending projects.

Financial gains are on the cards today, predicts Ganesha. Happiness will fly in as you receive some good news from an overseas friend. If you have feelings that you haven’t expressed to someone you dearly love, today is a good day to go ahead and let them know. The evening promises rejoicing and relaxation, says Ganesha. You may invite a group of faithful friends over to your place or catch up a film with someone close to your heart. Your heart may feel the depth of intimacy. You can indulge in cuddling wth your partner. A wonderful night is on the cards, says Ganesha. A great day is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. This is the right time to attend work that is incomplete on all the fronts. With your energy levels moving upwards, you shall easily complete your tasks by end of the day. It is better to think twice before spending a huge sum. You should not take decisions blindly and should see to it that money is spent in right direction at right time. Forget unnecessary things for the time being. This is an excellent day to show your creative instinct. A sense of accomplishment should make you feel satisfied at work today. You’ve been working very hard. Therefore, your brain definitely deserves a break, feels Ganesha. Work on the projects that need your immediate attention and approval, says Ganesha.

Emotional and material security will hold equal importance today. You want to be in love, but you know that love can’t buy you dough. In academics, you will be able to solve whatever problems you set your mind on. Your spare time will be spent on devising methods of making the best use of your knowledge. Today, you will make crucial choices concerning higher studies, predicts Ganesha. Your lovey-dovey attitude will appeal to your sweetheart, thus leading to a wonderful evening. Gossipping, teasing, cuddling and laughter will be some of the great recipes of the romantic night. A memorable time is on the cards, feels Ganesha. Today you may be in a mood to eat. You may wish to eat something of your choice. While you will surely enjoy food, you should remember that for good health – quantity also matters along with quality. Do not over-eat today. Ganesha suggests that you should remember that fast moving planets give only temporary happiness. Whatever you gain today may not give you lasting happiness, at least on the financial front. Today, you will be compassionate towards your fellow beings. Even your colleagues will appreciate you for your considerate attitude. You will approach tasks with enthusiasm and vigour. Your positive and versatile mindset will support you to finish important works on time, feels Ganesha.

When the going gets tough, it’s better to go with the flow. But you belong to a school of thought that believes that in such troubled times, it’s better to stay out of water altogether. Since it is not your day today, you are likely to postpone all important decisions and work. Ganesha approves. Your loved one will be happy and satisfied being with you. You will feel that you are spending the most amazing time with your loved one as you will understand your partner’s interests and need to have space, feels Ganesha. You will be in good health today. But, you are also likely to experience mood swings. You should avoid being over emotional about things as it may affect your health . Do not over-react to situations or people. Avoid fire to rise in your blood. Ganesha feels that today you shall be sensitive about financial matters. You may, though, get carried away by other people’s opinions. You need to be pragmatic and listen only to your inner voice. Today’s the best day of the month to plan a presentation. Just boost your confidence a bit. And then see your amazing presentation skills will come to the fore. Overcoming technical glitches will be child’s play for you. Work will be a fun today and your boss will applaud your ideas and effort.

Call it an epiphany of sorts, but today promises to be a day of revelations for you. Finally, things fall into place as your Odyssey nears its end, and you come to terms with your hidden talents, says Ganesha. Follow your heart and dive into the bottomless pool of your imagination. With limitless ideas, and a silver spoon to match your steady hand, you are perfectly poised to act on what you have thought out clearly. In romance, don’t let the differences of opinion affect your relationship. Remember, you fell in love with your partner precisely because you found him/her different from the others. You want to make yourself special in front of your partner. Therefore, make the night memorable, suggests Ganesha. You need to take good care of your health today. Running nose to blockage of nose – anything can bother you today so you better beware. You should take sleep for enough hours today, else you may end up feeling tired and worked up. Financial benefits will give you temporal joy only. Instead, it will be good to invest money on spiritual advancement, meditation classes or something that helps you gain peace of mind. Cosmic undercurrents say that you need to focus only on one most important project. Understand the projects you plan to handle to the last detail so that you minimise the chances of going wrong in the future. Also, this will make your task easy to accomplish, suggests Ganesha.

There is a strong indication that you will dabble in writing or performing arts, and emerge with excellent results. Since these are your passions, you may cultivate hobbies in these fields, if they are not already your profession. Enjoy the power you have over people today as you grip them with sweet words, swinging to your whims, says Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bottle Green You seem to be in high spirits. This attitude will melt your darling’s heart and make him/her agree to whatever you say. You are ruled by a deep emotion tonight and your appreciation for your lover will strengthen the current relationship, feels Ganesha. You will not face any major health issue today. You will have practical worries but there will be practical solutions too. You will stay energetic throughout the day. Your zeal will help you feel that ‘the day is going good’. Today you will be dealing with your finances very judiciously, feels Ganesha. You will not blow up your money impulsively on even things that you need to possess to maintain your level. An excellent day to begin a new job or a project! This is also the best day to give and take interviews. You are confident and ready to finish any task fast. Your active mind will not let you rest for a second.

Your family is the cornerstone of your success. And today is no different. Your auspicious day starts from your home, and you manage to carry this luck everywhere you go with the same tempo and gusto, predicts Ganesha. Your smile enables you to keep winning people to your side. Ganesha knows you are facing mounting work pressure. However, avoid being unfair to your loved one. Giving your partner utmost sincerity will be helpful in the long run. You may get some honey-filled compliments if you keep your relationship steady, feels Ganesha. Today, you will be able to perform multiple tasks without getting tired. You will be highly energetic today and you will use this energy properly. You will also be in a mood to take initiatives. It’s a good day from health perspective. Ganesha foresees that today is a very good day to focus on your career which will help bring more money. This is an auspicious day to learn about new ways and means to increase your financial standing. When the day begins, even your early achievement may not be able to help you see things clearly. However, a good time will relieve you in the second half of the day as the major workload will get lessened, feels Ganesha. Communication is likely to get better with your colleagues and superiors.

The target is locked in and the arrow is shot. It is only a matter of time before Cupid celebrates a bull’s eye and you find yourself in the mush of things. Sentiments and romance will be the order of the day. There is a good chance that marriage proposals or new relationships will find their footing today, says Ganesha. This is an ideal day to express your emotion in creative ways to stimulate your partner. Fortunately, your sweetheart will support you. You’ll be in quite a romantic mood today, and you will enjoy every moment of being together, feels Ganesha. You will be full of energy today. However, you should not use this energy in planning things. If you do so, you may end up making many changes in your plan and that’s not going to help you in any way. Today you shall have a fair idea about how much you want and how much you can let go. Such an attitude will help things to turn in your favour. In short, the day is good for negotiations. Ganesha foresees a lucky day for you. You will successfully wrap up routine tasks and then will get enough spaces to work on new projects. Your boss will be full of praise and appreciation for your dedication and performance.

Today, you will most certainly put your heart and soul into your work. But it is rather unlikely that you will get the returns in proportion to the efforts you put in. Yet, at the end of the day, you will be more than satisfied that you have got the chance to display your innate talents, says Ganesha. Mental disturbances are likely to occur as the current astral alignment may lead to conflicts between you and your lover. Be on your guards. Once your loved one gets hurt, do not forget to make her feel at home by singing a soulful song or preparing a delicious dish. You need to give priority to your health and stay focussed there. If you don’t give importance to your health today, you may end up falling sick. You should not tax your brain much and just remain as silent as possible. Ganesha predicts that today you are not going to be smart in financial dealings. You will be spending money without thinking deeply about gains or returns. You need to keep your fists tight. Be very careful of your words as jealous colleagues may plan to undermine your position in the office. If you turn aggressive, just tone down a bit to control the situation, suggests Ganesha. Today, small tasks will keep you engaged. Your primary objectives may get reshuffled.

New projects and partnership will keep you busy today, says Ganesha. If a meeting is scheduled, you may be praised vociferously for your ability to make the right decision at the right time. You may also bag rewards for the commendable efforts you’d put in the past. Your willingness to fulfill the demands of your sweetheart will help you enjoy a wonderful evening, says Ganesha. If you feel that you cannot melt his or her heart at a go, you can sing, dance or crack some nice jokes, says Ganesha. You may not be in full energy today. You may feel bit tired as the day progresses. You should deal with things that can give you feeling of accomplishment and must not get involved in thankless tasks. You should also have juice and energy boosters. As a rule you tend to be calculative when it comes to financial matters, and you spend only after careful thought. However, today, you are likely to be carried away by peer pressure. It seems that you are the most sought-after person in the office. However, unfortunately, it’s all work and no play today. Filling up the monthly planner will be on the top of your mind. Your priorities at the workplace may get reorganised, foresees Ganesha.

If Elvis Presley is who you dreamed of being, today may be your day! You seem to impress one and all, and even money flows in! You play smart today and everything seems to work in your favour. Take care, says Ganesha, things may not be as they seem. You seem to be tensed today because of certain internal conflict and may forget to talk about important matters to your loved one. Take a break and spend some time with your partner, suggests Ganesha. Perhaps you will be able to get all your desired solutions from your sweetheart. Today you should take things easy and avoid taking too much stress. You should not say ‘yes’ for everything and must learn to say ‘no’ to things that are not possible to handle today. Ganesha feels that you may face temporary health issue. Ganesha foresees that the stars are in your favour if you are about to start providing services to some organization. You may be paid well for your services. While quoting a price, ensure that you are not short-changed. Today may be the worst day at your workplace since you may not be able to manage or organize tasks properly, foresees Ganesha. Your seniors may disagree with you as you may not be decisive. With problems multiplying, you may lose your cool.

You can probably count your chickens before they hatch today, for it is likely that every nest-egg you expect to mint money will. A good day to trade in the stock markets as well, as long as you keep in mind that the horns of a rampaging Bull market can be every bit as deadly as the paws of a lumbering Bear market, says Ganesha. If you are planning for a baby, then this is the right day to make a move as it favours conception, foresees Ganesha. After all, you will be blissful realising that you are going to welcome an important member to your family. Your day is going to be good from health point of view. You will be at ease and in good mood. Your creativity will be very active today. You should keep yourself detached from anything that can trouble you emotionally. This is going to be a good day on the financial front, feels Ganesha. You will be able to spend money on yourself and family members. Fortunately, you will receive your desired financial benefits. It’s better if you avoid taking up any risky venture since Ganesha predicts that today’s astral configuration isn’t favourable. At work, you may fear that you will be the one to get the axe. You may turn indecisive in the second half, feels Ganesha.
